# Repository instructions for GitHub Copilot

Follow the complete repository rules in [`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md).
They are mandatory for every change, especially the reproducibility, public
repository privacy, protected-branch, and validation requirements.

Before changing bootstrap scripts, installation documentation, flake inputs,
Homebrew taps, CI, releases, or GitHub repository controls, also read
[`../docs/public-repository-security.md`](../docs/public-repository-security.md)
and use the tracked release/audit scripts described there.
